findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_data, annotate_genes, brassica_gene_view · Private data: search_data, find_germplasm, data_sources, bnapus_phenotypes, pangenome_gene_trait, snp_phenotypes, get_paper, protein_structure, brapi_germplasm_studies, blast_sequence, panel_haplotypes · Public sink: snp_haplotype_carriers, search_papers, brassica_gene_view, napus_homoeologue_expression, napus_progenitor_haplotypes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_data, annotate_genes, brassica_gene_view · Private data: search_data, find_germplasm, data_sources, bnapus_phenotypes, pangenome_gene_trait, snp_phenotypes, get_paper, protein_structure, brapi_germplasm_studies, blast_sequence, panel_haplotypes · Public sink: snp_haplotype_carriers, search_papers, brassica_gene_view, napus_homoeologue_expression, napus_progenitor_haplotypes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
